Name: Highlight Crops
Author: ninjor1
Description:
[size=5][b]Highlight Crops[/b][/size]
Press a key to see at a glance which of your tilled soil still needs seeds, and which crops are ready to harvest.

Press [b]Y[/b] to show the overlay, and again to hide it. While it's showing, a blue square is drawn over:
[list]
[*]each patch of tilled soil with nothing planted in it[/*]
[*]each crop which is ready to harvest[/*]
[/list]It works wherever you are. Growing crops, dead crops and garden pots aren't highlighted.

[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod into your game's [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Settings[/b][/size]
Edit [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] in the mod's folder, or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] in game.
[list]
[*][b]Toggle overlay[/b] ([font=Courier New]ToggleKey[/font], default [b]Y[/b]): the key which shows or hides the overlay.[/*]
[*][b]Highlight empty soil[/b] ([font=Courier New]HighlightEmpty[/font], default on): highlight tilled soil with nothing planted in it yet.[/*]
[*][b]Highlight ready crops[/b] ([font=Courier New]HighlightReady[/font], default on): highlight crops which are ready to harvest.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size]
Each player can install it or not; it only changes what you see. In split-screen, each player shows or hides their own overlay.

[size=4][b]Source code and bug reports[/b][/size]
The source code is on GitHub: [url=https://github.com/fnielson1/stardew-valley-mods]https://github.com/fnielson1/stardew-valley-mods[/url]
Please report bugs and suggestions as [url=https://github.com/fnielson1/stardew-valley-mods/issues]GitHub issues[/url].
